faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the National Book Trust Editorial Assistant posts?
faq.answer: The last date to submit your online application for the National Book Trust Editorial Assistant positions is 30th September 2026. It is advisable to apply well in advance of the deadline.

faq.question: Q2. What is the total number of vacancies released by National Book Trust?
faq.answer: National Book Trust has announced a total of 17 vacancies for the post of Editorial Assistant through this recruitment drive.

faq.question: Q3. What is the educational qualification required for the Editorial Assistant post?
faq.answer: Candidates must hold a Graduation degree. A Master's Degree in the specified language is considered desirable for the Editorial Assistant role.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for applying to the Editorial Assistant positions?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for all candidates applying for the Editorial Assistant posts is 40 years. Specific age relaxation details are not provided in the summary.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary offered for the Editorial Assistant role?
faq.answer: The selected candidates for the Editorial Assistant positions will receive a monthly salary ranging from Rs. 45,000/- to Rs. 55,000/-.

faq.question: Q6. How can I apply for the National Book Trust Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Applications must be submitted online through the official website of National Book Trust or via the direct application link provided in the important links section before the last date.

faq.question: Q7. Is there any application fee for the National Book Trust Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Based on the provided information, there is no mention of an application fee for the National Book Trust Recruitment 2026. Candidates are advised to check the official notification for confirmation.

faq.question: Q8. What is the mode of application for these posts?
faq.answer: The application process for the National Book Trust Editorial Assistant posts is strictly online. Offline applications will not be accepted.

faq.question: Q9. What is the job type for the Editorial Assistant positions?
faq.answer: The Editorial Assistant positions are offered on a contract basis as per the notification released by National Book Trust.
